findings: The proposal preserves every frozen R1 execution gate and does not alter deck rows, ordering corpus, sample size, allocation order, metrics, margins, caps, stop rules or no-retry semantics.

It correctly rejects observed/sampled loaded-class lists as a completeness argument and requires expected authority to derive from independently qualified immutable build artifacts and complete dependency closure.

It binds build inputs, resolved dependency graphs, ordered process classpaths/module paths, complete directory/archive inventories, resources, generated classes, JDK, OS/container/native identity, Python/shell/launcher chain and allowed environment rather than only source filenames or a small selected class list.
It explicitly separates expected-manifest authority from prepared-worker attestation, combined receiving, exclusive claim, execution authorization and official initialization.

It preserves fail-closed treatment of unknown loaders, agents, generated or hidden classes, duplicate/shadowed binaries, multi-release ambiguity, extension paths, later mutation and replayed or stale worker attestations.
It requires deterministic non-corpus receiving fixtures plus independent review before any manifest, worker or R1 authority can be accepted.
The additional complete-boundary requirements are stricter implementation detail for the frozen exact-runtime requirement; they do not relax or redesign the experiment.
required_next_gates: Atomically implement the versioned canonical complete-manifest schema, dependency/build graph and inventory verifier, sealed launch/lifetime policy, prepared-worker attestation channel and Python admission receiver.
Qualify that combined implementation with deterministic fail-closed fixtures under the repository's required build/verify path.
Independently review the implementation and its exact source pins.
Generate a candidate complete expected manifest from an isolated seed-free qualified build and immutable verified input store.
Independently review and adopt the exact candidate manifest digest and complete graph/loader/platform provenance.
Qualify the prepared worker against the adopted authority and complete combined receiving/runtime/payment/metrics/journal/replay/artifact gates.
Only after separate preclaim acceptance and exact R1 execution authorization may the existing claim and 512-allocation execution path be evaluated.
explicit_non_authority: No expected manifest is adopted by this review.
No implementation source is qualified by this review.
No prepared-worker or launcher identity is accepted by this review.
No combined receiving, claim, R1 permit, allocation, seed, initialization, action, outcome or deck conclusion is authorized.
The rejected eight-class capture remains incomplete candidate evidence only.
